items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So it might be Herschel or it might be Scott. ... [INTERVIEWER] Oh, so you may have had Scott got back. You may have had four saxes.

ctx.x: and you barely hear the trumpet in the... in the background it's away from the mics is that you or... that's me that's the whole brass section that way in the back of the reeds the reeds were on the front 된
So it might be Herschel or it might be Scott.

Yeah, at the beginning of the solo, to remind me of Herschel, but I have always been in doubt that Herschel was in the band. He possibly was just coming in there, but that was Bagby playing that clarinet.
